name: playbook
description: Find, organize, upload, share and publish creative assets in your Playbook workspace.

interface.longDescription: Playbook is a media backend for creative teams. This plugin connects your Playbook workspace so you can search images, video and documents by keyword or by what they show, organize them into folders, tag them and fill in custom fields, upload files from a URL, Google Drive or Dropbox, review version history, read the text of PDFs, and share a folder through a link, a published page or an email invitation. It acts as the signed-in Playbook user and reaches only the workspaces that account belongs to. It does not download file contents, read text inside images or scanned PDFs, or extract video captions.
defaultPrompt: What folders are in my Playbook workspace?
Find the logo files in Playbook and show me the newest ones.
Create a share link for one of my Playbook folders that expires in a week.

positive.description: List the folders of the workspace
positive.prompt: List all the folders in my Playbook workspace, including nested ones.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the folder titles of the test workspace: MCP Test at the top level, with Brand Kit, Product Photos and Campaign Drafts inside it.

positive.prompt: Find the assets tagged logo in Playbook.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the assets tagged logo in the test workspace with their titles and links.

positive.description: Create a folder and add a note to it
positive.prompt: Create a Playbook folder called Review Demo and add a note that says Kickoff on Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Review Demo folder, adds the note to it, and returns a link to the folder.

positive.prompt: Add the tag approved to the asset named Logo Primary in my Brand Kit folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Logo Primary and adds the tag approved to it, keeping its other tags.

positive.description: Share a folder with an expiring link
positive.prompt: Create a share link for my Brand Kit folder that expires in 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share URL for Brand Kit and states the expiry date.

negative.description: Reading file contents is not supported
negative.prompt: Download Logo Primary from Playbook and read me the raw file contents.

negative.description: Unpublishing a page is not supported
negative.prompt: Unpublish the published page of my Brand Kit folder.
Show me the folders of a Playbook workspace I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Uploads of files the assistant holds now take up to 2 GB: above 100 MB a file goes on its own, in slices. The get-started skill points to get_asset_download_urls for an asset's original file.
